claim_boundary: BLS publishes calendar-known Employment Situation release dates and times, and payroll and unemployment information can affect policy and cross-asset expectations. The release combines two surveys, revisions and an unknown surprise direction, while primary Bitcoin-macro evidence reports muted or unstable responses. Exactly one future preregistered audit may test a full-UTC-day cash veto; the calendar and literature do not establish alpha.

prior_matrix.finding: The official archived schedule lists the date, Eastern Time and identity of monthly Employment Situation releases.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: A scheduled release date does not encode payroll, unemployment or earnings surprises and does not establish a negative BTC return.

prior_matrix.finding: The official year archive lists recurring 08:30 Eastern Employment Situation releases for the Validation years.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Original point-in-time publication evidence must be cross-checked before BTC outcome access.

prior_matrix.identity: BLS Employment Situation archived news releases
prior_matrix.finding: BLS retains monthly release archives that can verify release identity and the next scheduled release without a paid API.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Release contents, revisions and realized surprise values are prohibited features for the calendar-only audit.

prior_matrix.identity: BLS Employment Situation methods quick guide
prior_matrix.finding: The release contains distinct household and establishment survey estimates with sampling, revision and measurement considerations.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The calendar-only policy cannot know which survey component or revision will dominate market interpretation.

prior_matrix.identity: Benigno and Rosa, The Bitcoin-Macro Disconnect, Federal Reserve Bank of New York Staff Report 1052
prior_matrix.finding: The study reports that Bitcoin reactions to macro news are often muted or unstable even when conventional assets respond.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: High-frequency surprise regressions do not directly test a full-day long-or-cash policy, fees, drawdown or opportunity cost.

future_design_requirements: Before BTC outcome access, freeze the exact official 2020-2024 monthly Employment Situation release-date list and verify point-in-time preannouncement through immediately preceding archived releases.
Use one complete UTC-day event interval and same-window non-event controls matched only to weekdays present in each frozen window.
Require Design and Validation support, return disadvantage, negative-rate difference, one-sided Fisher significance, drawdown path, annual breadth and loss concentration before economics.
Only after every predictive gate passes, run matched-capital BTC versus zero-yield-cash economics under normal and doubled adverse friction.

Do not add payroll, unemployment, earnings or revision surprise sign or magnitude, consensus forecasts, equities, yields, dollar, BTC trend, volatility, intraday windows, partial sizing, leverage or shorting.
Do not open post-2024 data; a historical pass remains REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED and requires separately sealed independent OOS.
uncertainty: This family shares a broad scheduled U.S. macro-announcement mechanism with the closed CPI and FOMC full-day vetoes, so it receives a lower independence rank despite a different information release.
Most releases occur on Friday, making same-weekday controls plentiful but limiting weekday diversity.
A complete UTC day is much wider than the 08:30 Eastern release window and may forgo positive drift unrelated to labor news.
No Employment-Situation-matched BTC return, path, strategy economics, post-2024 observation, hypothesis, candidate or OOS was accessed while freezing this prior.
